```{r qc_filtering, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: scRNA-seq data preprocessing and quality control filtering
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define quick clustering function
easy_clustering <- function(object, nfeatures = 3000, pcs = 50, dims = 1:30, resolution = 2){
  object <- FindVariableFeatures(object, nfeatures = nfeatures)
  object <- ScaleData(object, features = VariableFeatures(object))
  object <- RunPCA(object, features = VariableFeatures(object), npcs = pcs)
  object <- ScaleData(object, features = VariableFeatures(object)[1])
  object <- FindNeighbors(object, dims = dims)
  object <- FindClusters(object, resolution = resolution)
  object <- RunUMAP(object, dims = dims)
  return(object)
}

# ========== Load Data ==========
data.path <- c(
  "scRNA-seq/results/cellranger/Y1_outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/",
  "scRNA-seq/results/cellranger/Y2_outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/",
  "scRNA-seq/results/cellranger/O1_outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/",
  "scRNA-seq/results/cellranger/O2_outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/"
)

object.list <- list()
for (i in 1:length(data.path)) {
  object.list[[i]] <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Read10X(data.dir = data.path[i]), 
                                          min.cells = 1, min.features = 100)
  object.list[[i]]$stim <- c("Y1", "Y2", "O1", "O2")[i]
  object.list[[i]]$stage <- c("Anagen", "Telogen", "Anagen", "Telogen")[i]
  object.list[[i]]$age <- c("3 months", "2 months", "12 months", "18 months")[i]
}

merged <- merge(x = object.list[[1]], y = object.list[2:4], merge.data = TRUE)
merged[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(merged, pattern = "^mt-")
merged[["percent.rp"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(merged, pattern = "^Rp[ls][1-9]")
merged <- NormalizeData(merged)
merged <- easy_clustering(object = merged)

# ========== Automatic QC Filtering ==========
# First filter: based on nFeature_RNA < 600
cluster_stats <- merged@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(median_nFeature = median(nFeature_RNA), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(median_nFeature)
low_feature_clusters <- cluster_stats %>%
  filter(median_nFeature < 600) %>%
  pull(seurat_clusters) %>% as.character()
if (length(low_feature_clusters) > 0) {
  merged <- subset(merged, idents = setdiff(levels(merged), low_feature_clusters))
  merged <- easy_clustering(merged)
}

# Second filter: based on nCount_RNA < 1500
cluster_stats <- merged@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(median_nCount = median(nCount_RNA), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(median_nCount)
low_count_clusters <- cluster_stats %>%
  filter(median_nCount < 1500) %>%
  pull(seurat_clusters) %>% as.character()
if (length(low_count_clusters) > 0) {
  merged <- subset(merged, idents = setdiff(levels(merged), low_count_clusters))
  merged <- easy_clustering(merged)
}

# ========== Manual Filtering ==========
# Marker-based annotations (reference only, actual cluster numbers may vary)
# Fgf18: quiescence
# Endo: 12(VEC), 34(LEC)
# Muscle: 7, 36, 22
# satellite: 28
# Fibroblast: 16
# melanocyte: 1
# schwann cell: 39
# epithelial: 2,5,8,9,11,13,14,15,17,18,20,23,24,25,26,29,30,31,32,33,35,37,38,40,41,42,45,48
# dermal papilla cell: 0,3,4,6,10,19,27,50
# Doublets: 45,46,47,49,51
# immune:21,43,44,52

# Remove doublets and immune cells (update cluster numbers based on your results)
doublet_immune_clusters <- c(21, 43, 44, 52, 45, 46, 47, 49, 51)
merged <- subset(merged, idents = setdiff(levels(merged), doublet_immune_clusters))

# Extract hair follicle-related cells (update cluster numbers based on your results)
hair_clusters <- c(2,6,7,9,11,21,27,3,5,16,19,24,25,30,8,13,14,15,17,20,22,33,36,39,40,42,46,49,45,26,29,32,35,47,4,12,34,18,44)
merged_hair <- subset(merged, idents = hair_clusters)

# ========== Hair Follicle Cell Processing ==========
merged_hair <- easy_clustering(merged_hair)
```

```{r cell_annotation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Cell type annotation for hair follicle cells
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Cell Type Annotation ==========
# Map clusters to 5 major cell types based on marker genes
library(dplyr)

# Add majorCellType column using mutate
merged_hair <- merged_hair %>%
  mutate(majorCellType = case_when(
    seurat_clusters %in% c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12, 20, 22, 25, 26, 31) ~ "DP cell", #Fgf7
    seurat_clusters %in% c(5, 15, 18, 19, 23, 30) ~ "Activated HFSC",             #Sox9,Gata3,Krt14
    seurat_clusters %in% c(6, 21) ~ "Quiescent HFSC",                             #Sox9,Fgf18
    seurat_clusters %in% c(11, 14) ~ "Melanocyte",                                #Dct
    seurat_clusters %in% c(7, 9, 10, 13, 16, 17, 24, 27, 28, 29) ~ "Matrix cell", #Msx2
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# Set majorCellType as factor with fixed order

                                    levels = c("Matrix cell", "DP cell", "Activated HFSC",
                                               "Quiescent HFSC", "Melanocyte"))

# ========== Set stim Factor Levels ==========

merged_hair$stim <- factor(Idents(merged_hair), levels = c("Young_anagen", "Old_anagen", "Young_telogen", "Old_telogen"))
```

```{r mela_clustering}
# Description: Clustering analysis for melanocyte subpopulation
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Define Melanocyte Clustering Function ==========
mela_clustering <- function(object, nfeatures = 3000, dims = 1:30, pcs = 50, resolution = 0.6){
  object <- NormalizeData(object)
  object <- FindVariableFeatures(object, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = nfeatures)
  object <- ScaleData(object, features = rownames(object))
  object <- RunPCA(object, features = VariableFeatures(object), npcs = pcs)
  object <- FindNeighbors(object, dims = dims)
  object <- FindClusters(object, resolution = resolution)
  object <- RunUMAP(object, dims = dims)
  return(object)
}

# ========== Melanocyte Reclustering ==========
melanocyte <- mela_clustering(melanocyte)
melanocyte <- RenameIdents(melanocyte, 
                          '0' = 'M0',
                          '1' = 'M1',
                          '2' = 'M2',
                          '3' = 'M3')
melanocyte[["cellType"]] <- Idents(melanocyte)
```

```{r umap_visualization}
# Description: UMAP visualization for melanocyte subpopulations
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Visualization ==========
# Define colors
mycol <- c('#218380','#d81159','#ffbc42','#6a60a9')

# Custom UMAP plot with arrows and labels
# Extract UMAP coordinates
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(melanocyte, "umap"))
colnames(umap_df) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
umap_df$celltype <- melanocyte$cellType

# Calculate median position for each cell type as label position
label_df <- umap_df %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(
    x = median(UMAP1),
    y = median(UMAP2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate coordinate ranges
x_min <- min(umap_df$UMAP1)
x_max <- max(umap_df$UMAP1)
y_min <- min(umap_df$UMAP2)
y_max <- max(umap_df$UMAP2)

x_range <- x_max - x_min
y_range <- y_max - y_min
dx <- x_range * 0.15
dy <- y_range * 0.15

# Generate plot
p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = celltype), size = 2) +
  # Bottom-left arrows
  annotate("segment", x = x_min, xend = x_min + dx, y = y_min, yend = y_min,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("segment", x = x_min, xend = x_min, y = y_min, yend = y_min + dy,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Arrow labels
  annotate("text", x = x_min + dx/2, y = y_min - y_range*0.05, label = "UMAP1", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_min - x_range*0.05, y = y_min + dy/2, label = "UMAP2", angle = 90, size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mycol) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p1)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte", "umap_total.png"),
       plot = p1, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Split UMAP by sample (custom version)
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(melanocyte, "umap"))
colnames(umap_df) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
umap_df$celltype <- melanocyte$cellType
umap_df$stim <- melanocyte$stim

# Calculate coordinate ranges
x_min <- min(umap_df$UMAP1)
x_max <- max(umap_df$UMAP1)
y_min <- min(umap_df$UMAP2)
y_max <- max(umap_df$UMAP2)

x_range <- x_max - x_min
y_range <- y_max - y_min
dx <- x_range * 0.15
dy <- y_range * 0.15

# Generate split plot
p2 <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = celltype), size = 2) +
  # Bottom-left arrows
  annotate("segment", x = x_min, xend = x_min + dx, y = y_min, yend = y_min,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("segment", x = x_min, xend = x_min, y = y_min, yend = y_min + dy,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Arrow labels
  annotate("text", x = x_min + dx/2, y = y_min - y_range*0.05, label = "UMAP1", size = 9) +
  annotate("text", x = x_min - x_range*0.05, y = y_min + dy/2, label = "UMAP2", angle = 90, size = 9) +
  facet_wrap(~ stim, nrow = 2, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mycol) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.clip = "off"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6)))

print(p2)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte", "umap_split.png"),
       plot = p2, width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

```{r volcano_plot}
# Description: Differential expression analysis and volcano plot for melanocyte subpopulations
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Differential Expression Analysis ==========
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tibble)

# Create subset containing M1 and M2 cells
melanocyte_subset <- subset(melanocyte, idents = c("M1", "M2"))

# Set new identity combining cell type and condition
melanocyte_subset$celltype_stim <- paste0(melanocyte_subset$cellType, "_", melanocyte_subset$stim)
Idents(melanocyte_subset) <- "celltype_stim"

# Check available ident combinations
print(table(Idents(melanocyte_subset)))

# Adjust comparison groups based on actual ident names
# Example: M1_Old_anagen vs M2_Young_anagen - modify according to your data
ident.1 <- "M1_Old_anagen"
ident.2 <- "M2_Young_anagen"

# Extract differentially expressed genes
m2_young_vs_m1_old <- FindMarkers(melanocyte_subset,
                                 ident.1 = ident.1,
                                 ident.2 = ident.2,
                                 logfc.threshold = 0,
                                 min.pct = 0.1)

# Filter significant DEGs
m2_young_vs_m1_old_sig <- m2_young_vs_m1_old %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)

print(head(m2_young_vs_m1_old_sig, 20))

# ========== Volcano Plot ==========
# Prepare volcano plot data
lfc_cutoff <- 0.25
p_cutoff   <- 0.05

m2_young_vs_m1_old_volcano <- rownames_to_column(m2_young_vs_m1_old, "gene")
m2_young_vs_m1_old_volcano <- m2_young_vs_m1_old_volcano %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      p_val_adj < p_cutoff & avg_log2FC >  lfc_cutoff  ~ "Up_in_M1_Old",
      p_val_adj < p_cutoff & avg_log2FC < -lfc_cutoff  ~ "Up_in_M2_Young",
      TRUE ~ "Not_Sig"
    ),
    label = ifelse(p_val_adj < 0.01 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.6, gene, "")
  )

# Count genes in each group
n_m1_old   <- sum(m2_young_vs_m1_old_volcano$group == "Up_in_M1_Old")
n_m2_young <- sum(m2_young_vs_m1_old_volcano$group == "Up_in_M2_Young")
n_total <- n_m1_old + n_m2_young

subtitle_text <- paste0(
  "Up_in_M1_Old: ", n_m1_old, " | ",
  "Up_in_M2_Young: ", n_m2_young, " | ",
  "Total DEGs: ", n_total
)

# Set colors
pal <- c("Up_in_M1_Old" = "#d81159", "Up_in_M2_Young" = "#218380", "Not_Sig" = "grey80")

# Generate volcano plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(m2_young_vs_m1_old_volcano, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "M1_Old vs M2_Young",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10(adj. p-value)",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(volcano_plot)

# Save volcano plot
ggsave(
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte", "M1_Old_vs_M2_Young_volcano.png"),
  plot = volcano_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r tf_activity_analysis}
# Description: Transcription factor activity analysis using dorothea/viper
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Transcription Factor Activity Analysis ==========
library(Seurat)
library(dorothea)
library(dplyr)
library(viper)
library(ggplot2)

# Load mouse transcription factor regulons from dorothea
data(dorothea_mm, package = "dorothea")
tf_regulons <- dorothea_mm

# Select high confidence A/B regulons
tf_regulons_high <- tf_regulons %>%
  dplyr::filter(confidence %in% c("A", "B"))

# Subset M1 and M2 cells
Idents(melanocyte) <- "cellType"
melanocyte_subset <- subset(melanocyte, idents = c("M1", "M2"))

# Create combined identity with cell type and condition
melanocyte_subset$celltype_stim <- paste0(melanocyte_subset$cellType, "_", melanocyte_subset$stim)
Idents(melanocyte_subset) <- "celltype_stim"

# Ensure RNA assay is default
DefaultAssay(melanocyte_subset) <- "RNA"

# Run VIPER for TF activity inference
melanocyte_subset <- run_viper(
  melanocyte_subset,
  regulon = tf_regulons_high,
  options = list(
    method      = "scale",
    minsize     = 3,
    eset.filter = FALSE,
    cores       = 1,
    verbose     = FALSE
  )
)

# Identify TF activity assay
assay_candidates <- Assays(melanocyte_subset)
assay_name <- assay_candidates[grepl("dorothea|viper", assay_candidates)][1]
DefaultAssay(melanocyte_subset) <- assay_name
Idents(melanocyte_subset) <- "celltype_stim"

# Differential TF activity analysis
tf_deg <- FindMarkers(
  object = melanocyte_subset,
  ident.1 = "M1_Old_anagen",
  ident.2 = "M2_Young_anagen",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.1
)

tf_deg <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tf_deg, "TF")

# Filter significant TFs
tf_DE <- tf_deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.1)

# Save results
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "melanocyte"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(tf_DE, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "melanocyte", "TF_M1_Old_vs_M2_Young.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Plot significant TFs
sig_tfs <- tf_deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.1) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_log2FC)))

if(nrow(sig_tfs) > 0) {
  # Create bar plot for TF activity differences
  tf_plot <- ggplot(sig_tfs, aes(x = reorder(TF, avg_log2FC), y = avg_log2FC, 
                                fill = avg_log2FC > 0)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#218380", "TRUE" = "#d81159"), 
                      labels = c("Higher in M2_Young", "Higher in M1_Old")) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = "Differential TF Activity: M1_Old_anagen vs M2_Young_anagen",
      x = "Transcription Factors",
      y = "log2 Fold Change",
      fill = "Activity Direction"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
    )
  
  print(tf_plot)
  
  # Save figure
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte", "tf_activity_barplot.png"),
         plot = tf_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r regulatory_network_visualization}
# Description: TF-target gene regulatory network construction and visualization
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== TF-Target Regulatory Network Construction ==========
library(dplyr)

# Extract significant TF names
significant_tf_names <- sig_tfs$TF

# Extract TF-target relationships from DoRothEA database
tf_target_relationships <- tf_regulons_high %>%
  filter(tf %in% significant_tf_names)

# Get all differentially expressed genes
de_genes <- rownames(m2_young_vs_m1_old_sig)

# Find overlap: DE genes regulated by significant TFs
regulated_de_genes <- tf_target_relationships %>%
  filter(target %in% de_genes)

# Summarize target genes per TF
tf_summary <- regulated_de_genes %>%
  group_by(tf, confidence) %>%
  summarise(
    n_targets = n(),
    target_genes = paste(target, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_targets))

# Save results
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "melanocyte"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(tf_summary, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "melanocyte", "tf_target_summary.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(regulated_de_genes, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "melanocyte", "regulated_de_genes.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# ========== TF-Target Regulatory Network Visualization ==========
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)

# Prepare network data
network_edges <- regulated_de_genes %>%
  dplyr::select(tf, target) %>%
  distinct()

# Identify genes upregulated in M1_Old and M2_Young
de_genes_m1_old <- m2_young_vs_m1_old_sig %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>%  # Upregulated in M1_Old
  rownames()

de_genes_m2_young <- m2_young_vs_m1_old_sig %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC < 0) %>%  # Upregulated in M2_Young
  rownames()

# Create graph object
g <- graph_from_data_frame(network_edges, directed = TRUE)

# Set node attributes
V(g)$type <- ifelse(V(g)$name %in% significant_tf_names, "TF", "Target")

# Set node color groups
V(g)$group <- ifelse(
  V(g)$name %in% significant_tf_names, "TF",
  ifelse(
    V(g)$name %in% de_genes_m1_old, "Up_in_M1_Old",
    ifelse(
      V(g)$name %in% de_genes_m2_young, "Up_in_M2_Young", "Other"
    )
  )
)

# Generate network plot
set.seed(123)
p_network <- ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(
    alpha = 0.6, 
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, 'mm')), 
    end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'),
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    aes(color = group, size = type), 
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    repel = TRUE, 
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = 100,
    segment.color = "grey70",
    segment.size = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Gene Group",
    values = c(
      "TF" = "#8B4513",           # Brown for TFs
      "Up_in_M1_Old" = "#D81159", # Red for upregulated in M1_Old
      "Up_in_M2_Young" = "#218380", # Teal for upregulated in M2_Young
      "Other" = "grey70"          # Grey for others
    ),
    labels = c(
      "TF" = "Transcription Factor",
      "Up_in_M1_Old" = "Up in M1_Old", 
      "Up_in_M2_Young" = "Up in M2_Young", 
      "Other" = "Other"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    name = "Node Type",
    values = c("TF" = 5, "Target" = 3),

  ) +
  theme_void() +

    title = "TF-Target Regulatory Network",

  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 16),
```

```{r monocle2_trajectory}
# Description: Monocle2 trajectory analysis for melanocyte subpopulations
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Monocle2 Trajectory Analysis ==========
library(monocle)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)

# Filter cells (keep M0, M1, M2)
melanocyte_filtered <- subset(melanocyte, idents = c("M0", "M1", "M2"))

# Build Monocle2 object
expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(melanocyte_filtered, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
cell_metadata <- melanocyte_filtered@meta.data
gene_annotation <- data.frame(
  gene_short_name = rownames(expr_matrix),
  row.names = rownames(expr_matrix)
)

cds <- newCellDataSet(
  expr_matrix,
  phenoData = new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = cell_metadata),
  featureData = new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = gene_annotation),
  expressionFamily = negbinomial.size()
)

cds <- estimateSizeFactors(cds)
cds <- estimateDispersions(cds)

# Select trajectory genes
diff_genes <- differentialGeneTest(
  cds,
  fullModelFormulaStr = "~cellType",
  cores = 4
)

ordering_genes <- rownames(diff_genes[order(diff_genes$qval), ])[1:2000]
cds <- setOrderingFilter(cds, ordering_genes)

# Dimensionality reduction + ordering
cds <- reduceDimension(
  cds,
  max_components = 2,
  method = "DDRTree",
  norm_method = "log",
  pseudo_expr = 1
)

cds <- orderCells(cds)

# Set M0-enriched state as root
state_table <- table(pData(cds)$State, pData(cds)$cellType)
m0_rich_state <- names(which.max(prop.table(state_table, margin = 1)[, "M0"]))
cds <- orderCells(cds, root_state = m0_rich_state)
```

```{r branch_analysis}
# Description: Branch-dependent gene expression analysis using BEAM
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Branch-Dependent Gene Analysis (BEAM) ==========
library(monocle)
library(dplyr)

# Prepare data
pt <- pData(cds)

############################################################
# Define branch analysis function
############################################################
analyze_branch <- function(cds, bp_id, stateA, stateB, output_dir) {

  # 1. BEAM: identify branch-dependent genes
  beam_res <- BEAM(
    cds,
    branch_point = bp_id,
    progenitor_method = "duplicate",
    cores = 20
  )
  beam_res <- beam_res[order(beam_res$qval), ]
  
  # Filter significant genes (q < 0.05)
  q_cutoff <- 0.05
  beam_sig <- rownames(beam_res[beam_res$qval < q_cutoff, ])
  
  # Ensure genes exist in expression matrix
  beam_sig <- beam_sig[beam_sig %in% rownames(cds)]
  
  # Skip if no significant genes
  if (length(beam_sig) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # 2. Calculate log2FC between stateA and stateB
  cells_A <- rownames(pt[pt$State == stateA, ])
  cells_B <- rownames(pt[pt$State == stateB, ])
  
  expr_mat <- exprs(cds)[beam_sig, c(cells_A, cells_B)]
  
  mean_A <- rowMeans(expr_mat[, cells_A, drop = FALSE])
  mean_B <- rowMeans(expr_mat[, cells_B, drop = FALSE])
  
  log2FC <- log2((mean_B + 1e-6) / (mean_A + 1e-6))
  
  # Get corresponding q-values
  qvals <- beam_res[beam_sig, "qval"]
  
  branch_df <- data.frame(
    gene        = beam_sig,
    qval        = qvals,
    mean_stateA = mean_A,
    mean_stateB = mean_B,
    log2FC      = log2FC
  )
  
  names(branch_df)[3:4] <- c(
    paste0("mean_state", stateA),
    paste0("mean_state", stateB)
  )
  
  # 3. Classify genes based on branch bias
  fc_cutoff <- 0.25
  branch_df$group <- ifelse(
    branch_df$log2FC >  fc_cutoff,
    paste0("Up_in_state", stateB),
    ifelse(
      branch_df$log2FC < -fc_cutoff,
      paste0("Up_in_state", stateA),
      "No_bias"
    )
  )
  
  # 4. Save results
  out_file <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("mela_BP%d_state%d_vs_state%d_BEAM_fate_program.csv", bp_id, stateA, stateB))
  write.csv(branch_df, out_file, row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(branch_df)
}

############################################################
# Execute analysis for both branch points
############################################################
# Create output directory
output_dir <- file.path("results", "tables", "melanocyte")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Branch point 1: state1 vs state2
branch1_result <- analyze_branch(cds, bp_id = 1, stateA = 1, stateB = 2, output_dir = output_dir)

# Branch point 2: state3 vs state5
branch2_result <- analyze_branch(cds, bp_id = 2, stateA = 3, stateB = 5, output_dir = output_dir)

# Store results in list
beam_results <- list(
  branch1 = branch1_result,
  branch2 = branch2_result
)
```

```{r beam_volcano_visualization}
# Description: Volcano plot visualization for BEAM branch analysis results
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== BEAM Branch Volcano Plot Visualization ==========
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Define volcano plot function
plot_beam_volcano <- function(branch_result, bp_id, stateA, stateB, output_dir) {
  
  # Get data from branch_result
  volcano_df <- branch_result
  
  # Add -log10(qval) column
  volcano_df$neglog10q <- -log10(volcano_df$qval + 1e-20)
  
  # Set thresholds
  q_cutoff <- 0.05
  fc_cutoff <- 0.25
  
  # Classify genes
  volcano_df$group <- "Not_sig"
  volcano_df$group[
    volcano_df$qval < q_cutoff & volcano_df$log2FC > fc_cutoff
  ] <- paste0("Up_in_state", stateB)  # log2FC > 0 indicates up in stateB
  
  volcano_df$group[
    volcano_df$qval < q_cutoff & volcano_df$log2FC < -fc_cutoff
  ] <- paste0("Up_in_state", stateA)  # log2FC < 0 indicates up in stateA
  
  # Label significant genes (optional)
  volcano_df$label <- ifelse(
    volcano_df$group != "Not_sig" &
    abs(volcano_df$log2FC) > 0.5 &
    volcano_df$neglog10q > 10,
    volcano_df$gene,
    ""
  )
  
  # Color settings
  color_values <- c(
    "#d81159",  # Up_in_stateA
    "#218380",  # Up_in_stateB
    "grey70"    # Not_sig
  )
  names(color_values) <- c(
    paste0("Up_in_state", stateA),
    paste0("Up_in_state", stateB),
    "Not_sig"
  )
  
  # Generate volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FC, y = neglog10q, color = group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff),
               linetype = 2, color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(q_cutoff),
               linetype = 2, color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Branchpoint ", bp_id, ": State", stateA, " vs State", stateB),
      x = paste0("log2FC (State", stateB, " / State", stateA, ")"),
      y = "-log10(q-value)",
      color = "Gene Class"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  # Save figure
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, "figures", "melanocyte", 
                         sprintf("BEAM_branch%d_state%d_vs_state%d_volcano.png", 
                                 bp_id, stateA, stateB)),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

# Generate volcano plots for both branch points
if (!is.null(branch1_result)) {
  p1 <- plot_beam_volcano(
    branch_result = branch1_result,
    bp_id = 1,
    stateA = 1,
    stateB = 2,
    output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR
  )
}

if (!is.null(branch2_result)) {
  p2 <- plot_beam_volcano(
    branch_result = branch2_result,
    bp_id = 2,
    stateA = 3,
    stateB = 5,
    output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR
  )
}
```

```{r top_genes_trend}
# Description: Pseudotime trend plots for top branch-dependent genes
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Branch Gene Expression Trend Plots ==========
############################################################
# 0. Subset cells by state and condition for each branch
############################################################
# Branch A: state4 -> state3 -> state1 (old individuals)
cells_A <- rownames(pData(cds))[
  pData(cds)$State %in% c(4, 3, 1) & pData(cds)$stim %in% c("Old_anagen", "Old_telogen")
]
cds_A <- cds[, cells_A]

# Branch B: state4 -> state3 -> state2 (young individuals)
cells_B <- rownames(pData(cds))[
  pData(cds)$State %in% c(4, 3, 2) & pData(cds)$stim %in% c("Young_anagen", "Young_telogen")
]
cds_B <- cds[, cells_B]

############################################################
# 1. Select top genes by q-value from branch point 1 results
############################################################
# Read branch point 1 results
branch_df <- read.csv("results/tables/melanocyte/mela_BP1_state1_vs_state2_BEAM_fate_program.csv")

# Set branch parameters
stateA <- 1
stateB <- 2

# Ensure qval is numeric
if ("qval" %in% colnames(branch_df)) {
  branch_df$qval <- as.numeric(as.character(branch_df$qval))
} else {
  branch_df$qval <- 1:nrow(branch_df)
}

# Extract upregulated genes for each branch
branchA_df <- subset(branch_df, group == paste0("Up_in_state", stateA))
branchB_df <- subset(branch_df, group == paste0("Up_in_state", stateB))

# Sort by q-value
if (nrow(branchA_df) > 0) {
  branchA_df <- branchA_df[order(as.numeric(branchA_df$qval)), ]
}
if (nrow(branchB_df) > 0) {
  branchB_df <- branchB_df[order(as.numeric(branchB_df$qval)), ]
}

# Select top 5 genes per branch (or all if fewer)
n_top <- 5
topA_genes <- head(branchA_df$gene, min(n_top, nrow(branchA_df)))
topB_genes <- head(branchB_df$gene, min(n_top, nrow(branchB_df)))

all_genes <- unique(c(topA_genes, topB_genes))

# Stop if no genes found

  ncol = 5,
  nrow = 2
) + 
  ggtitle(paste0("Branch A: State ", stateA, " Fate Program"),

  scale_color_manual(values = state_colors) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray50"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))

print(pA)

# Branch B plot
pB <- plot_genes_in_pseudotime(
  cds_B[all_genes, ],
  color_by = "State",
  ncol = 5,
  nrow = 2
) + 
  ggtitle(paste0("Branch B: State ", stateB, " Fate Program"),
          subtitle = paste("States:", paste(c(4, 3, stateB), collapse = " -> "))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = state_colors) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray50"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))

print(pB)

############################################################
# 3. Save results
############################################################
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte", sprintf("branch_A_%d_genes.png", length(all_genes))),
  plot = pA, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte", sprintf("branch_B_%d_genes.png", length(all_genes))),
  plot = pB, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r dual_branch_expression}
# Description: Comparative expression trends of genes across two fate branches
# Workflow: Part 04 - scRNA-seq validation

# ========== Dual-Branch Gene Expression Trend Comparison ==========
library(monocle)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

############################################################
# Parameter Configuration
############################################################

# 1. Branch configuration
stateA <- 1  # State 1 (Old-anagen fate)
stateB <- 2  # State 2 (Young-anagen fate)

# 2. Plot parameters
state_colors <- c("1" = "#FF6347", "2" = "#4682B4", "3" = "#32CD32", "4" = "#FFD700")

# 3. Y-axis optimization parameters
coverage <- 0.95     # Percentage of fitted curve to cover
y_buffer <- 0.1      # Buffer ratio
min_points <- 10     # Minimum cell count

# 4. Output parameters
output_dir <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "melanocyte")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
output_file <- "fate_branch_gene_expression.png"

############################################################
# Core Plotting Function
############################################################

plot_gene_dual_branch_optimized <- function(gene, cds_A, cds_B, 
                                            stateA_label = "Old-anagen fate",
                                            stateB_label = "Young-anagen fate") {
  
  # 1. Extract expression data for the gene in both branches
  cells_A <- rownames(pData(cds_A))
  expr_A <- exprs(cds_A[gene, cells_A])[1, ]
  
  df_A <- data.frame(
    Pseudotime = pData(cds_A)$Pseudotime,
    Expression = as.numeric(expr_A),
    Branch = stateA_label,
    State = as.factor(pData(cds_A)$State),
    Cell = cells_A
  )
  
  cells_B <- rownames(pData(cds_B))
  expr_B <- exprs(cds_B[gene, cells_B])[1, ]
  
  df_B <- data.frame(
    Pseudotime = pData(cds_B)$Pseudotime,
    Expression = as.numeric(expr_B),
    Branch = stateB_label,
    State = as.factor(pData(cds_B)$State),
    Cell = cells_B
  )
  
  # 2. Check data sufficiency
  if (nrow(df_A) < min_points | nrow(df_B) < min_points) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # 3. Fit curves for both branches
  fit_A <- tryCatch({
    loess(Expression ~ Pseudotime, data = df_A, span = 0.7, 
          control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    lm(Expression ~ Pseudotime, data = df_A)
  })
  
  df_A$Fitted <- predict(fit_A)
  
  fit_B <- tryCatch({
    loess(Expression ~ Pseudotime, data = df_B, span = 0.7,
          control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    lm(Expression ~ Pseudotime, data = df_B)
  })
  
  df_B$Fitted <- predict(fit_B)
  
  # 4. Calculate optimal Y-axis range based on fitted values
  all_fitted <- c(df_A$Fitted, df_B$Fitted)
  
  q_low <- quantile(all_fitted, probs = (1 - coverage)/2, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(all_fitted, probs = 1 - (1 - coverage)/2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  fitted_range <- c(q_low, q_high)
  range_span <- diff(fitted_range)
  
  if (range_span < 0.1 * diff(range(all_fitted, na.rm = TRUE))) {
    range_span <- 0.5 * diff(range(all_fitted, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  
  y_center <- mean(fitted_range)
  y_half_range <- range_span/2 * (1 + y_buffer)
  y_limits <- c(y_center - y_half_range, y_center + y_half_range)
  
  y_limits[1] <- min(y_limits[1], min(all_fitted, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_limits[2] <- max(y_limits[2], max(all_fitted, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_limits[1] <- max(0, y_limits[1])
  
  # 5. Combine data
  df_combined <- rbind(df_A, df_B)
  df_combined$Branch <- factor(df_combined$Branch, 
                               levels = c(stateA_label, stateB_label))
  
  # 6. Create plot
  p <- ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = Pseudotime, y = Expression)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    geom_point(aes(color = State), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, 
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.05)) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = Branch), method = "loess", span = 0.7,
                color = "black", linewidth = 1.2, se = TRUE, 
                fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Branch, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_color_manual(values = state_colors, 
                       name = "Cell State") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    labs(title = gene, x = "Pseudotime", y = "Expression Level") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5)),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(15, "points")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

############################################################
# Main Execution
############################################################

# Ensure all_genes exists from previous analysis
if (!exists("all_genes")) {
  stop("Please run branch point 1 analysis first to generate all_genes list")
}

plot_list <- list()
success_count <- 0

for (i in seq_along(all_genes)) {
  gene <- all_genes[i]
  
  p <- plot_gene_dual_branch_optimized(
    gene = gene,
    cds_A = cds_A,
    cds_B = cds_B,
    stateA_label = paste0("State ", stateA, " (Old-anagen)"),
    stateB_label = paste0("State ", stateB, " (Young-anagen)")
  )
  
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[gene]] <- p
    success_count <- success_count + 1
  }
}

if (success_count > 0) {
  n_col <- 5
  n_row <- ceiling(success_count / n_col)
  
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = n_col, guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  output_path <- file.path(output_dir, output_file)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = output_path,
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = 8 * n_col,
    height = 5 * n_row,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  print(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r multiple_genes_violin}
# Description: Violin plots for multiple gene expression across cell types and conditions

# ========== Multiple Gene Expression Violin Plots ==========
library(ggpubr)

# List of genes to plot

              features = genes_to_plot, 
              group.by = "majorCellType",
```
